description_expanded: AboutSandy Shores on 30A | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental with Golf Cart Included, Fire Pit, and Prime Location Near Gulf Place Home Highlights • 4 Bedrooms and 3 Bathrooms, Sleeps 9 – Spacious layout perfect for families and groups • Prime 30A location near Gulf Place, Blue Mountain Beach, and top dining • 6-seater street legal golf cart included for easy beach access and exploring 30A • Private fenced backyard with fire pit, outdoor dining, outdoor grill, and outdoor shower • Front deck ideal for people watching along Scenic Highway 30A • Open concept living with coastal luxury design and natural light • Two ensuite bedrooms for added privacy and comfort • Fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliances, crockpot, coffee maker, Keurig coffee machine, and spices • 2 adult bikes and 2 child bikes for exploring 30A • Beach gear included: wagon, 4 backpack chairs, umbrella, and beach towels • Family-friendly amenities including pack and play and high chair • Dedicated workspace with desk, perfect for remote work or planning your day on 30A • Complimentary starter amenities including Starbucks coffee, bottled water, and essentials • Full-size washer and dryer for added convenience during your stay • Close to the beach, restaurants, shopping, and entertainment Experience the Best at Sandy Shores on 30A Welcome to Sandy Shores on 30A, a beautifully designed 30A vacation rental where location, comfort, and coastal charm come together for the perfect beach getaway. Ideally situated along Scenic Highway 30A, this home places you right in the heart of everything guests love about the Emerald Coast. Whether you are enjoying morning coffee on the front deck while taking in the vibrant energy of 30A, relaxing in your private backyard oasis, or cruising to the beach in the included golf cart, Sandy Shores on 30A delivers a seamless and memorable vacation experience. Prime Location Near Gulf Place and Blue Mountain Beach Sandy Shores on 30A offers one of the most desirable locations along 30A. You are just minutes from: • Gulf Place Town Center • Blue Mountain Creamery • Mimmo’s Italian Restaurant • Boutique shopping and local art galleries • Scenic bike paths and nature trails • Some of the most beautiful beaches along the Emerald Coast Walk, bike, or take the golf cart to explore the area with ease. Open Concept Living Designed for Gathering Step inside and enjoy a bright, open concept layout filled with coastal luxury finishes and comfortable furnishings. The spacious living area flows seamlessly into the dining and kitchen spaces, making it perfect for: • Family gatherings • Group vacations • Relaxing after a day at the beach Large windows bring in natural light, creating an inviting and relaxing atmosphere throughout the home. Fully Equipped Kitchen for Easy Entertaining The kitchen at Sandy Shores on 30A is thoughtfully designed for both convenience and entertaining, featuring: • Stainless steel appliances • Fully stocked cookware and utensils • Crockpot for easy meals • Traditional coffee maker and Keurig coffee machine • Spacious countertops and prep space Whether you are preparing breakfast before the beach or hosting a family dinner, everything you need is at your fingertips. Comfortable Bedrooms with Ensuite Options Sandy Shores on 30A features four well-appointed bedrooms designed for rest and relaxation, including: • Two private ensuite bedrooms for added comfort and privacy, one with a private balcony • Thoughtfully designed spaces for families and groups • High-quality bedding and furnishings The layout offers flexibility for multi-family stays, couples, or group getaways. Private Backyard Oasis with Fire Pit One of the standout features of Sandy Shores on 30A is the fully enclosed backyard, offering a private space to relax and unwind. Enjoy: • Outdoor dining area perfect for evening meals • Fire pit for gathering under the stars • Outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach • Comfortable seating for relaxing and entertaining This backyard creates the perfect setting for both quiet mornings and memorable evenings. Beach Days Made Easy Everything you need for a perfect beach day is included: • 6-seater street legal golf cart • Beach wagon for easy transport • 4 backpack beach chairs • Beach umbrella • Beach towels Getting to the beach is quick and effortless, allowing you to spend more time enjoying the sand and surf. Explore 30A by Bike or Golf Cart With included bikes and a golf cart, exploring 30A has never been easier. Ride along the scenic bike path or take a short trip to nearby hotspots, restaurants, and shops. Sandy Shores on 30A puts you in the center of it all. Family-Friendly Amenities Traveling with children is easy at Sandy Shores on 30A with thoughtful amenities including: • Pack and play • High chair • Games and movies for entertainment The home is designed to accommodate guests of all ages comfortably. Thoughtful Extras for a Stress-Free Stay Your stay includes a complimentary starter package with: • Starbucks coffee • Creamer and sugar • Bottled water • Spices • Bathroom and kitchen essentials These details help you settle in quickly and start enjoying your vacation right away. Your Ideal 30A Getaway Starts Here With its unbeatable location, private outdoor space, included golf cart, and thoughtfully designed interiors, Sandy Shores on 30A offers everything you need for a memorable 30A vacation. Whether you are here for beach days, dining, shopping, or simply relaxing with family and friends, this home delivers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal luxury. Book your stay at Sandy Shores on 30A today and experience the best of Scenic Highway 30A.
